output: Hypothesis: There is a statistically significant relationship between gender and degree completion rates in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79) dataset. Specifically, the mean highest grade completed differs significantly between males and females. This relationship is supported by an independent samples t-test, which yielded a t-statistic of -5.69 and a p-value of approximately 1.29e-08, indicating a highly significant difference in degree completion rates between the two genders.
